exactSourceStatements: Established in 1895, La Biennale had an attendance of over 800,000 visitors
The history of the La Biennale di Venezia dates back from 1895, when the first International Art Exhibition was organized
In the 1930s new festivals were born: Music, Cinema, and Theatre
In 1980 the first International Architecture Exhibition took place
in 1999 Dance made its debut at La Biennale
